Subject: Pilot success metrics & ops workshop — next steps and schedule

Hi Alyssa — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- What we heard: FinLytics wants a pilot to validate latency and cost per query for your 2-3 highest-throughput endpoints, plus assurance around audit logs and data segregation.
- Primary success metrics you called out: p95 latency < 300ms, average inference cost <$0.015/token equivalent, and end-to-end request auditability for compliance.
- Short-term asks from Redwood: schedule a technical workshop (demo + sandbox access) with your infra and procurement teams so we can surface SSO and data-retention details.

Proposed next step — 45–60m technical workshop where we:
1) run a short live demo against a representative workload,
2) walk through security/retention architecture with your platform/security lead,
3) align on MAP milestones (pilot success criteria + timelines).

Can you share two preferred 60-minute windows next week? To get the right people on the invite I’ve cc’d Marissa (solutions) and Karthik (platform). I’ve attached a first-draft mutual action plan (20240822-MAP-v1.pdf) — it’s a starting point for milestones and responsibilities.

If helpful, here are a few windows from our side:
- Tuesday 8/27 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wednesday 8/28 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thursday 8/29 09:00–10:00 PT

Thanks — I’ll hold these tentatively for 24 hours.

Best,
Sean Gallagher

Thanks Sean — great summary. We’re definitely interested in moving to a short pilot to validate those metrics. I’ve looped in our procurement lead Tom Reynolds (tom.reynolds@finlytics.com) and our internal procurement mailbox (procure@finlytics.com) so they can see the MAP and timeline.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Success metrics above look right; I’ll confirm the exact token-equivalent pricing target with Tom.
- For the workshop, our security lead is still finalizing schedules — I’ll introduce them separately but please plan to cover SSO and logs.

Of your proposed slots, Wednesday 8/28 14:00–15:00 PT works best for our team. If you can include a <45m pre-demo segment for procurement questions (Tom) that would be helpful.

Also — could you add a quick one-page checklist of what we should have ready on our side (SSO creds, sample payload, who needs sandbox access)?

Appreciate it — sending Tom’s contact now.

Hi all — thanks for locking this in. I’m Karthik (platform at Redwood) — I’ll run the demo and handle sandbox access. A few quick asks so we can make the session as productive as possible: 

1) Please add a point-of-contact who can approve sandbox SSO for 8/28 (email + calendar invite acceptance) — we’ll need at least one Platform or Infra engineer.
2) Sample payloads: if you can drop a representative payload (or a small sample set) to the Drive folder before EOD Monday that’ll help us pre-benchmark.
3) If you rely on an allowlist for outgoing IPs, share the egress CIDR ranges or confirm we can provide a short windowed exception during the pilot.

I’ve updated the MAP with a short technical checklist and added a calendar placeholder link: https://redwood.app/mutual-action-plan/FL-2024-042 — please confirm ownership on the MAP so we can assign remediation owners quickly post-workshop.

If all good I’ll send a calendar invite with the playbook and a 20m procurement pre-call attached to the main invite for Tom.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
